experiment: E1 abstraction-level census of fix commits

classes.structural: root cause is expressible as a change to the component set or the edges between components: a component/module missing or extra, a relationship missing/extra/reversed, a dependency crossing a boundary it should not (including an undeclared external dependency), or the fix landing in a different component than the one where the symptom appeared
classes.intra-module: condition, default, async/ordering, platform difference, rendering geometry inside one component, text/copy, thresholds
classes.cannot-judge: diff does not carry enough evidence

litmus: structural iff a component+relationship-level map (no line numbers) could plausibly have surfaced the defect

totals.note_merge_duplicates: 6 of the 50 are merge commits pulled in because --grep matches the whole message, not only the subject; 5 of them duplicate a non-merge fix also present in the list. Excluding all 6 merges: 7/44 = 15.9% structural, same band.

sensitivity.borderline_structural_downgraded: if the 4 borderline structural calls (2ead014, 82e63c9, 5de7275/c8594f3, a097c2d) are read as intra-module: 3/50 = 6.0% (below 15%)
sensitivity.borderline_intra_upgraded: if the 4 borderline intra-module calls (06dd052, 8323a15, 3b5035f, 50e2e63) are read as structural: 12/50 = 24.0%
sensitivity.conclusion: the point estimate and both sensitivity bounds stay below 30%; the >=30% structural-narrative gate is never reached
